name: AdamW
description: Adam with decoupled weight decay. The default optimizer for most LLM training.
notes: 2x parameter memory for optimizer states (FP32 m and v buffers). AdamW decouples weight decay from the adaptive update (original Adam folds L2-in-loss into per-parameter rates); bias correction is retained from Adam.
defaultHyperparams: lr per recipe, betas (0.9, 0.95), eps 1e-8, weight decay 0.01-0.1, grad clip 1.0
whenToUse: Default for LLM pretraining and fine-tuning.
rule: Tune LR first, decay second, betas last.
failureModes: Decaying norms/biases (exclude them); forgetting LRs don't transfer across batch sizes.

name: SGD
description: Simple stochastic gradient descent, with or without momentum.
notes: Minimal memory. Momentum adds 1× parameter memory. Sometimes used for fine-tuning.
defaultHyperparams: lr higher than Adam (no adaptivity), momentum 0.9 adds 1x param memory
whenToUse: Rarely for transformers above 1B; sometimes late-stage fine-tuning.
rule: Only with momentum; expect longer convergence.
failureModes: Stagnation on ill-conditioned landscapes without adaptivity.

name: Adam
description: Original Adam optimizer with bias correction.
notes: Same memory as AdamW (2x FP32 states). L2 regularization added to the loss is rescaled by Adam's per-parameter adaptivity — the behavior AdamW's decoupled decay avoids.
defaultHyperparams: Same memory as AdamW (2x FP32 states)
whenToUse: Legacy default; prefer AdamW (decoupled decay behaves correctly under adaptivity).
failureModes: L2-in-loss interacting with adaptive rates (the bug AdamW fixes).

name: 8-bit Adam
description: Block-wise quantized Adam states. Halves optimizer memory with error feedback.
notes: m and v stored in 8-bit blocks. Small convergence risk on sensitive runs - verify against FP32 states.
defaultHyperparams: Same as AdamW; block size 2048 typical
whenToUse: Memory-bound fine-tuning where full Adam states don't fit.
rule: Verify final quality matches FP32-state runs on your evals.
failureModes: Rare divergence on outlier-heavy runs; falls back to verifying with full states.
